description: This Java class defines the strategy for handling delete commands for 'ThingDefinition' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It processes delete commands, interacts with 'Thing' entities, and produces deletion events and results.

classes.name: DeleteThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class that extends 'AbstractThingCommandStrategy' to provide delete handling logic for 'ThingDefinition' commands.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete operation, generating a result with a 'ThingDefinitionDeleted' event if the definition is accessible, or an error result if not.

methods.name: extractDefinition
methods.description: Extracts the 'ThingDefinition' from a given 'Thing' entity, throwing an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: getDeleteDefinitionResult
methods.description: Builds the result object representing a successful deletion of a 'ThingDefinition', including event details.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag (ETag) of the previous 'Thing' definition if available, aiding in concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no specific entity tag for the next state.
